(rule!
  (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list (objects g 0))])
    (let ((border (append
                   (for/list ([c (in-range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1))]) (list (obj-r1 obj) c))
                   (for/list ([c (in-range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1))]) (list (obj-r2 obj) c))
                   (for/list ([r (in-range (+ (obj-r1 obj) 1) (obj-r2 obj))]) (list r (obj-c1 obj)))
                   (for/list ([r (in-range (+ (obj-r1 obj) 1) (obj-r2 obj))]) (list r (obj-c2 obj))))))
      (paint-cells out border (obj-color obj)))))
